expected_visuals.1: A backhoe bucket resting on a flattened earth mound beside a new house at night
expected_visuals.2: Narrator sits on a bed under a lamp, staring at his swollen foot
expected_visuals.3: Low angle up at a dark ceiling; a faint shadow crosses the light
expected_visuals.4: He kneels at the flattened mound offering rice, an egg and tobacco on a banana leaf
expected_visuals.5: Calm morning-blue light in the quiet house, the hallway empty
expected_visuals.6: Hallway toward the daughter's half-open door; a trail of tiny muddy footprints leads into the house and up the stairs

visual_review.instructions: Two frames per clip (a = 25%, b = 75%). Confirm each clip shows its expected visual, clips are in story order, no clip repeats, no text/watermark/garbled faces, characters stay consistent.
